responsibility: Directive handler that begins translation of BRIG function, kernel, signature, and indirect-function declarations/definitions into GCC `FUNCTION_DECL`s and initial function trees. It creates the function signature, hidden runtime arguments for context/group/private memory, return-value temporaries, initial bind/block structure, kernel entry/exit labels, visibility and inline attributes, and frontend bookkeeping objects, while distinguishing declarations from definitions and kernels from ordinary callable functions.
